program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid_p":  (12.0, 8.0, 15.0),     # pass device gm/Id at ILOAD_MAX (tt)
    "L_p":     (0.2, 0.15, 0.4),      # pass device L
    "gmid_in": (15.0, 10.0, 20.0),    # OTA diff-pair gm/Id
    "L_ota":   (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # OTA pair/load L
    "itail":   (20e-6, 10e-6, 30e-6), # OTA tail current
    "vsh":     (0.4, 0.3, 0.55),      # level shift of VREF/FB (pair CM = 0.6+vsh)
    "cout":    (1e-6, 3e-7, 1e-6),    # internal output capacitor
    "zr":      (0.4, 0.15, 1.0),      # ESR-zero / gate-pole frequency ratio
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    vref = spec.get("vref", 0.6); vo = spec.get("vout_target", 1.2)
    imax = spec.get("iload_max", 5e-3); imin = spec.get("iload_min", 50e-6)
    iref = 10e-6
    idiv = 5e-6
    R2 = vref / idiv; R1 = (vo - vref) / idiv          # 120k / 120k
    Rth = R1 * R2 / (R1 + R2)
    ish = 2e-6                                         # shift current (each side)
    ipb = 2e-6                                         # PMOS bias reference
    Rs_ref = p["vsh"] / ish
    Rs_fb = max(Rs_ref - Rth, 1e3)                     # cancels shift + divider loading
    vcm = vref + p["vsh"]
    it = p["itail"]; Lo = p["L_ota"]

    # ---- bias network (NMOS ref diode, L=1, gm/Id=12) ----
    gmb, Lb = 12.0, 1.0
    mb0 = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, iref, vds=0.65)
    mtl = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, it, vds=0.35)
    mbp = lut.size("n", gmb, Lb, ipb, vds=0.8)
    mp0 = lut.size("p", 10.0, 1.0, ipb, vds=0.9)       # PMOS diode
    mps = lut.size("p", 10.0, 1.0, ish, vds=0.65)      # shift sources

    # ---- OTA: NMOS pair, PMOS mirror load ----
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid_in"], Lo, it / 2, vds=0.45)
    m3 = lut.size("p", 10.0, Lo, it / 2, vds=0.85)
    A = m1.gm / (m1.gds + m3.gds)
    Ro = 1.0 / (m1.gds + m3.gds)

    # ---- pass device, headroom-checked at ss/-40C, VIN=1.62 ----
    ipass = imax + idiv
    lw = lut.at("ss", -40)
    m1w = lw.op("n", m1.W, Lo, m1.vgs, 0.45)
    vgs_pair_w = max(m1.vgs, m1.vgs + (m1w["vth"] - m1.vth))
    gate_min = vcm - vgs_pair_w + 0.15
    vsg_lim = 1.62 - gate_min

    def vsg_for(lt, W, L, I, vds):
        lo, hi = 0.2, 1.8
        for _ in range(40):
            mid = 0.5 * (lo + hi)
            if lt.op("p", W, L, mid, vds)["Id"] < I: lo = mid
            else: hi = mid
        return hi

    gmid = p["gmid_p"]
    mp = lut.size("p", gmid, p["L_p"], ipass, vds=0.4)
    while vsg_for(lw, mp.W, p["L_p"], ipass, 0.42) > vsg_lim and mp.W < 4500 and gmid < 15.5:
        gmid += 0.5
        mp = lut.size("p", gmid, p["L_p"], ipass, vds=0.4)
    mfp = int(min(200, max(1, math.ceil(mp.W / 40.0))))

    # ---- compensation: series-R zero on internal Cout ----
    Cg = mp.cgg + mp.cgd
    wg = 1.0 / (Ro * Cg)
    Cout = p["cout"]
    Resr = min(max(1.0 / (p["zr"] * wg * Cout), 0.5), 40.0)

    n = Netlist("vin vout vref vss ibias")
    # bias
    n.dev("MB0", "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb0)
    n.dev("MT", "tail", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mtl)
    n.dev("MBP", "pb", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mbp)
    n.dev("MP0", "pb", "pb", "vin", "vin", mp0)
    n.dev("MS1", "vrefs", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)
    n.dev("MS2", "fbs", "pb", "vin", "vin", mps)
    # level shift
    n.R("RSR", "vrefs", "vref", Rs_ref)
    n.R("RSF", "fbs", "tap", Rs_fb)
    # divider
    n.R("R1", "vout", "tap", R1)
    n.R("R2", "tap", "vss", R2)
    # OTA (fbs on diode side: vout up -> gate up -> less pass current)
    n.dev("M1", "d1", "fbs", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M2", "gate", "vrefs", "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3", "d1", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    n.dev("M4", "gate", "d1", "vin", "vin", m3)
    # pass device
    n.dev("MPASS", "vout", "gate", "vin", "vin", mp, m=mfp)
    # internal output capacitor with series zero resistor
    n.R("RZ", "vout", "nesr", Resr)
    n.C("CO", "nesr", "vss", Cout)

    beta = R2 / (R1 + R2)
    T = beta * A
    dvsg = math.log(imax / imin) / max(gmid, 1.0) + 0.1
    load_reg = dvsg / T / (imax - imin)
    line_reg = mp.gds / (T * mp.gm) + 1.0 / (T * 20)
    psrr = -db(line_reg)
    t_slew = Cg * dvsg / it
    undershoot = imax * Resr + imax * t_slew / (2 * Cout) + 0.02
    iq = iref + it + ipb + 2 * ish + idiv
    err = 100.0 * (0.15 / T) / vo
    return n, {"vout_err_pct": err, "load_reg": load_reg, "line_reg": line_reg,
               "psrr_1k": psrr, "iq": iq, "undershoot": undershoot,
               "overshoot": imax * Resr, "ripple_settled": 2e-3}
